en.headline: Court remands man charged over liquid-splashing incidents in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: A 26-year-old IT technician surnamed Cheng was denied bail after being charged with indecent assault and causing grievous bodily harm relating to alleged attacks on women on escalators.
body: A 26-year-old man surnamed Cheng, an IT technician, appeared at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts and was denied bail after the prosecution opposed the defence application.

He faces charges of indecent assault and inflicting grievous bodily harm. The main charge relates to an alleged incident on 2 October near exit C of Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station, where he is accused of splashing unknown liquid on a woman on an escalator; she suffered a fractured finger while trying to stop him leaving.

Police have linked him to two similar alleged incidents in January, one at iSquare shopping mall and one at the same MTR station. He is due to appear again on Friday for a bail review. He remains remanded in custody.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀淋液案26歲男被控猥褻侵犯 法庭拒絕保釋還押
zh.dek: 一名26歲資訊科技技術員鄭姓男子因涉嫌在尖沙咀向女子淋潑不明液體，被控猥褻侵犯及傷人，西九龍裁判法院拒絕保釋申請，將他還押。
body: 26歲鄭姓男子在西九龍裁判法院提堂，面對猥褻侵犯及造成身體嚴重傷害等控罪。辯方申請保釋遭控方反對，法官聽取雙方陳述後拒絕保釋，將他還押看管。
案情指，他涉嫌於10月2日在尖沙咀港鐵站C出口附近扶手電梯向一名女子淋潑不明液體，事主試圖阻止他離開時手指骨折。警方亦將他與今年1月在尖沙咀另一商場及港鐵站的兩宗類似案件聯繫。
被告將於周五再次出庭進行保釋覆核。案件仍在調查中。
